function.name: search_locations
function.description: Searches for locations (roads or intersections) by name.

location_name.description: The name of the location to search for.

location_type.description: The type of the location to search for. Can only be 'road' or 'intersection'. If not specified, both types are searched.

function.name: get_road_details
function.description: Gets the details of a road by its unique identifier.

road_id.description: The unique identifier of the road to get details for.

function.name: get_intersection_details
function.description: Gets the details of an intersection by its unique identifier.

intersection_id.description: The unique identifier of the intersection to get details for.

function.name: search_route
function.description: Searches for the optimal route between an origin and a destination.

origin_id.description: The unique identifier of the origin location (road or intersection).

destination_id.description: The unique identifier of the destination location (road or intersection).

max_results.description: The maximum number of routes to return.

function.name: check_traffic_lights_states
function.description: Checks the current states of traffic lights (including both vehicle and pedestrian lights) at a specific intersection.

intersection_id.description: The unique identifier of the intersection to check.

function.name: manage_traffic_light_state
function.description: Changes the state of a traffic light at a specific intersection, either immediately or at a scheduled time.

intersection_id.description: The unique identifier of the intersection where the traffic light is located.

traffic_light_id.description: The unique identifier of the traffic light to change, concatenated by the type and the direction, e.g., 'vehicle-north-south'. The type can be 'vehicle' or 'pedestrian'. Typically there will be two lights per intersection: 'north-south' for the north-south direction and 'east-west' for the east-west direction.

traffic_light_state.description: The new state of the traffic light. For 'vehicle' lights, can be 'red', 'green', 'yellow', or 'hazard'; for 'pedestrian' lights, can be 'walk', 'stop', or 'flashing'.

start_time.description: The start time of the command in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'. If not provided, the command takes effect immediately.

end_time.description: The end time of the command in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'.

function.name: monitor_traffic_congestion
function.description: Monitors the traffic congestion level on a specific road or intersection.

location_id.description: The unique identifier of the road or intersection to monitor.

function.name: predict_traffic_congestion
function.description: Predicts traffic congestion at a specific road or intersection in the future based on historical data and current conditions.

location_id.description: The unique identifier of the road or intersection to predict congestion for.

prediction_start_time.description: The start time of the prediction in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'.

prediction_end_time.description: The end time of the prediction in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'.

function.name: analyze_traffic_patterns
function.description: Analyzes traffic patterns at a specific road or intersection over a specified period in the past.

location_id.description: The unique identifier of the road or intersection to analyze.

start_time.description: The start time of the period in the past to analyze in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'.

end_time.description: The end time of the period in the past to analyze in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'.

function.name: give_priority_to_emergency_vehicle
function.description: Gives priority to an emergency vehicle by changing vehicle lights at specific intersections.

intersection_ids.description: The unique identifiers of the intersections where priority should be given.

start_time.description: The start time of the priority period in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'.

end_time.description: The end time of the priority period in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'.

function.name: give_priority_to_public_transportation
function.description: Gives priority to a public transportation vehicle by changing vehicle lights at specific intersections during peak hours.

intersection_ids.description: The unique identifiers of the intersections where priority should be given.

start_time.description: The start time of the priority period in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'.

end_time.description: The end time of the priority period in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'.

function.name: schedule_road_maintenance
function.description: Schedules road maintenance at a specific road or intersection.

location_id.description: The unique identifier of the road or intersection to schedule maintenance for.

start_time.description: The start time of the maintenance in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'.

end_time.description: The end time of the maintenance in the format 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'.
